findings.claim: Step's own DoD requires parsing 'with the code: prefix handled', but parse_flexibee never calls _strip_code on any field it extracts, so the acceptance criterion is met only by an isolated unit test of a dead helper, not by the parser's actual behaviour.
findings.fix: Apply _strip_code to every ref-like field parsed from FlexiBee (e.g. typDokl, or any other code:-prefixed value the invoice model is meant to carry), or add such a field to FlexibeeInvoice and wire _strip_code into _parse_invoice, so an end-to-end parse_flexibee test proves the prefix is actually stripped from real parsed data instead of testing the helper function directly.
